notes: Portable public-API translation of the verified 21-assertion native NRG-disabled constrained-TAR regulator-activation witness. The adapter supplies a complete FOM with the standard nonRegulatedGrant switch disabled, endpoint, logical-time implementation and callback model. A constrained receiver requests a strict TAR while there is no regulator and receives no grant; a second joined federate then enables time regulation with lookahead greater than the request, and the receiver obtains one Time Advance Grant at the requested time. The public switch getter confirms the FOM precondition. Direct mappings are the native page-188-l87-26 to IEEE 1516.1-2025 clause 8.2, page-189-l162-44 to clause 8.3.1, and page-194-l21-3 and page-194-l69-19 to clause 8.8.3. The disabled-switch check is supplemental public-API setup; no extra requirement or complete NRG scheduling claim is invented. Official-header C++ primary and contract passed twice in evoked and immediate models against installed package libraries. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime result.
